name: disk-cleanup
description: Find what is consuming disk space — large files, large directories, full filesystems — and propose safe cleanups.
prompt: Start with `df -h` to find which filesystem is full, then `du -sh` on the suspect mount, then `find ... -size +<N>M`. Never `rm` without listing candidates first and asking the operator to approve.
examples: 磁盘快满了,帮我看哪些大文件
